study_scope: Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 14. Guangxi under Cao's provincial definition excludes independently tabulated Guangdong, Guizhou and Yunnan. Longzhou is a treaty port in Guangxi under Article II of the 1887 additional convention (https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1887/d185). The province total has no separate port count. CHGIS 195016 is a 1911 comparison feature only.

Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 15. Yunnan under Cao's provincial definition. The 1887 additional convention places Mengzi and its trade route in Yunnan (https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1887/d185). Separate frontier residents and later local boundary changes cannot be measured from this series. Use the historical statistical account only. CHGIS 195017 is a 1911 comparison feature.

Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 10. Shanxi (山西) under Cao's distinct statistical definition. CHGIS 195011 includes Hohhot at its 1911 date. The population series gives no separate count for that frontier locality and is not mapped onto a modern provincial footprint. Historical Shaanxi (陕西) and the row for Inner Mongolia are separate Cao series.
